user.title: Add an XP-Master
user.description: The address of the XP-Master (its name, e.g. xpm-e177.local, or its IP address). For an XP-Master other than the one this Home Assistant runs on, open a pairing window first: in that XP-Master's Netroni panel, Remote Access → Pair a Home Assistant or app.

pair.title: Pair with {name}
pair.description:
In the Netroni panel of {name}, open Remote Access and choose **Pair a Home Assistant or app**. Enter the 6-digit code it shows (also on the XP-Master's display).

Check that the XP-Master's display shows the same XP-Master: {master}.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the XP-Master.
error.invalid_code: Wrong code, or the pairing window has closed. Open a new one in the XP-Master's Netroni panel.

abort.not_netroni: The discovered device is not an XP-Master.
abort.not_local: This XP-Master's software has no remote access yet: update it first.
abort.restore_pending: This XP-Master is already set up under its earlier id: see Settings → Repairs to restore its settings.
abort.wrong_master: That is another XP-Master than this one.

menu_options.matter: Matter: SmartThings, Google Home, Alexa, Apple Home

tunable_white.title: Configure ports
tunable_white.description: Pick the XP-Mini to configure. Use its Identify Port buttons to find the fixtures if needed.

ports.title: Tunable-white ports on {mini}
ports.description: Tick a port to make it one tunable-white light (Port nT): A is warm white, B is cool white. Untick it to split it back into two dimmable lights, Port nA and Port nB.

confirm.title: Change the lights of {mini}?

matter.title: Matter Connections
matter.description:
Matter lets SmartThings, Google Home, Alexa and Apple Home control the XP-Mini lights. The XP-Master is paired with:

{apps}

matter_qr.title: Pair with a Matter app
matter_qr.description:
In SmartThings, Google Home, Alexa or Apple Home, choose to add a Matter device and scan this code:

![Matter pairing QR code]({qr})

Or enter the setup code **{code}**.

{window}

factory_reset.title: Factory reset an XP-Mini
factory_reset.description: Pick the XP-Mini to reset. Only connected XP-Minis are listed: to forget one that was taken away, delete its device instead.

reset_confirm.title: Reset {mini} to factory settings?
reset_confirm.description:
{mini} ({uid}) forgets all its settings and its lights go off. The {product} forgets it too: it is found again as a new XP-Mini, with default light names, no areas and the first free DMX block. Automations, scenes and dashboards that use its lights may have to be updated.

To restart it without losing anything, use its Restart button instead.

Submit to reset.

replace.title: Replace an XP-Mini
replace.description: Mount the new XP-Mini in the place of the one that is gone, connect it, then pick both here.

replace_confirm.title: Replace {old} with {new}?
replace_confirm.description:
**{new}** ({new_uid}) takes the place of **{old}** ({old_uid}): its DMX block {dmx}, port settings, light names, areas and groups. The lights keep their entities, so automations, scenes, dashboards and Matter apps keep working.{lost}

Submit to replace.

restart.title: Restart an XP-Mini
restart.description: Pick the XP-Mini to restart. It keeps all its settings and is back within a few seconds; its lights may flicker off meanwhile. Each XP-Mini also has a Restart button on its device page.

updates.title: XP-Master updates
updates.description:
This XP-Master runs release {installed}. New releases appear under Settings → Updates; nothing is installed until you press Install.

Beta releases come earlier and are less tested: for test and demo installations.

abort.not_loaded: The XP-Master is not connected. Try again when it is online.
abort.mini_gone: That XP-Mini is no longer part of this XP-Master.
abort.matter_unavailable: The Matter bridge of the XP-Master is not running.
abort.matter_starting: The Matter bridge of the XP-Master is starting. Try again in a minute.
abort.matter_done: The new app can pair with the XP-Master for 3 minutes, using the QR code or the setup code.
abort.reset_done: {mini} was reset. It is back as a new XP-Mini at DMX {dmx}.
abort.reset_done_gone: {mini} was reset. It has not been found again yet; it appears as a new XP-Mini once it is.
abort.nothing_to_replace: No XP-Mini is offline: only one that is gone can be replaced.
abort.replace_done: {old} now runs on the new XP-Mini.
abort.updates_unsupported: This XP-Master's Netroni service does not support updates yet.
abort.updates_beta: This XP-Master now gets beta releases.
abort.updates_stable: This XP-Master now gets stable releases only.

pair_port.name: Make port tunable white
pair_port.description: Turns Port nA (warm) and Port nB (cool) of an XP-Mini into one tunable-white light, Port nT. The two single lights are replaced and lose their names and areas.

unpair_port.name: Split tunable-white port
unpair_port.description: Splits Port nT of an XP-Mini back into Port nA and Port nB. The tunable-white light is replaced and loses its name and area.

confirm.title: {name} is offline
confirm.description:
{name} ({uid}) no longer answers so its lights can't be controlled.

Check its Visio-Link cable and power supply; this message disappears as soon as it is back.

If {name} was taken away on purpose, remove it from the XP-Master: its lights, names and DMX block are deleted. If it is connected again later, it will be added as a new XP-Mini.

abort.not_loaded: The XP-Master is not connected. Try again when it is online.
abort.resolved: This XP-Mini is back online or already removed.
abort.remove_failed: The XP-Master could not remove it: {error}

mini_replacement.title: New XP-Mini {name}: is it a replacement?

choose.title: New XP-Mini {name}
choose.description: {name} ({uid}) was found while another XP-Mini is offline. If it was mounted in that one's place, it can take over its lights, names, areas, groups and DMX block.

confirm.title: Replace {old} with {new}?
confirm.description:
**{new}** ({new_uid}) takes the place of **{old}** ({old_uid}): its DMX block {dmx}, port settings, light names, areas and groups. The lights keep their entities, so automations, scenes, dashboards and Matter apps keep working.{lost}

Submit to replace.

abort.not_loaded: The XP-Master is not connected. Try again when it is online.
abort.resolved: Nothing to do any more: the XP-Minis concerned are back, replaced or removed.

confirm.title: Restore the settings of {name}?
confirm.description:
Home Assistant's backup holds settings of this XP-Master that it doesn't have: configuration version {version} with {minis} XP-Minis (it has version {current}). This happens after restoring a backup onto a new or re-flashed XP-Master.

Restoring brings back its XP-Minis, DMX blocks, light names, areas, groups and the lights' last state. The Netroni service restarts; the lights keep their entities.

Submit to restore.

other_master.title: {name} is another XP-Master now
other_master.description:
This XP-Master's Netroni service now has id {new}, but its devices in Home Assistant belong to {old}, and Home Assistant's backup has no settings of {old} to restore. The XP-Master is not set up, so its devices and entities are kept.

Restore a Home Assistant backup that was made on {old}, or delete this XP-Master under Settings → Devices & services and add it again.
